## Intake Decision

No commit in this tail supplies the missing external scientific MCP,
automation authority, browser-control, or annotation architecture. The pair
command is valuable future remote-access UX but is privileged user-only
credential/network administration, not agent authority. Ghostty is a separate
terminal-platform program requiring prohibited visual/accessibility proof. No
code, workflow, mobile surface, credential model, release authority, or donor
ancestry is selected.
